name: Early Settlement
blurb: Job Charnock's factory grows into a town on three villages: the old fort, the first churches, the first burial grounds — most of it swept away in the sack of 1756.

name: Company Raj
blurb: After Plassey. The Palladian 'City of Palaces' of the East India Company, the Bengal Renaissance, and the merchant houses of the north.

name: Imperial Capital
blurb: Crown rule. Calcutta as capital of British India — Gothic and Indo-Saracenic public works, museums, courts and colleges.

name: Late Raj & Art Deco
blurb: The capital leaves for Delhi. Calcutta answers with the Victoria Memorial, Art Deco cinemas and the Howrah Bridge.

name: Independent India
blurb: What the city has built, converted or memorialised since 1947.

name: Date Undetermined
blurb: Listed heritage with no construction date on public record — most of them ordinary streets-corner buildings that outlived their builders' paperwork.
